title: Reusable metadata validation script + quality report
context: Every documented dataset needs an automated check that its canonical record is complete and well-formed, plus a quality/completeness report. This reusable script runs in CI and underpins the completeness-score (before/after) used across documentation tasks. It must never require or commit individual-level data. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Deliver a reusable metadata validation script that validates a canonical record against the schema and emits a completeness/quality report, as a PR with CI integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Script validates a canonical record against the canonical-metadata-model schema and reports missing/invalid fields.
Emits a completeness/quality report with a before/after completeness score (out of 100) usable by documentation tasks.
Runs clean in CI on committed fixtures (synthetic/public metadata only); no individual-level data required or committed.
Code MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint green; DCO signed-off.
output: scripts/validate-metadata.mjs plus a generated report under output/
